## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed sector performance (Energy, Utilities, Financials, Healthcare positive vs seven sectors negative) and material megacap divergences (several large-cap techs show 1W/1M mismatches), supporting a neutral stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +5.44% | 1M: +30.31%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +22.35%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities strong: VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%) ABOVE TREND. Financials marginally positive: JPM (1W: +0.29% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -1.71% | 1M: +1.43%) CORRECTION.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication weak: TTWO (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -7.65%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -5.33%) BELOW TREND. Industrials weak: UNP (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -6.26% | 1M: -9.32%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak: BKNG (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -2.97% | 1M: -5.05%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +8.91% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.03% | 1M: +14.68%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +7.07% | 1M: -4.02%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: UNP (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -1.50%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -6.00% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -6.26% | 1M: -9.32%) BELOW TREND, PLTR (1W: -6.42% | 1M: +11.81%) CORRECTION, MNST (1W: -6.49% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select industrials and travel exposure.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Highest 1W movers: DE (1W: +10.03%), VST (1W: +8.91%), CEG (1W: +8.03%), INTC (1W: +7.07%), META (1W: +6.70%). Major divergence flagged among large caps (MSFT, V, MA, INTC, PLTR), implying tactical uncertainty and watch-for-confirmation rather than conviction.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed tech: NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +2.51%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +0.16%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -5.33%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W: -0.70% — select leaders offset broader weakness.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials mixed but marginally positive: JPM (1W: +0.29% | 1M: +0.66%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -1.71% | 1M: +1.43%) CORRECTION; sector 1W: +0.43% — look for follow-through in banks vs payments.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare flat-to-positive: JNJ (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +7.63%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +1.07% | 1M: -1.69%) RECOVERY, LLY (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -3.43%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W: +0.15% — mixed earnings and trial news driving dispersion.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to Energy and Utilities leaders (MPC, VLO, VST) and maintain positions in high-conviction tech winners (NVDA, META) while reducing exposure to the weakest pockets of Consumer Discretionary and Communication. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; allow confirmation before scaling core exposures.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND — momentum to test higher; DE (1W: +10.03% | 1M: +12.80%) ABOVE TREND — industrial breakout candidate. BEARISH: MSFT (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +0.16%) CORRECTION — watch for follow-through to the downside; ADBE (1W: -8.58% | 1M: +2.41%) CORRECTION — headline-driven risk.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.76%, leaders MPC, VLO) and Utilities (1W: +2.10%, leaders VST, CEG) — breadth concentrated but strong. BEARISH: Communication and Consumer Discretionary (both negative 1W) — monitor headline risk and booking trends.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA: hold above near-term breakout (monitor 1W pivot) for continuation (ABOVE TREND). AAPL: watch 1M support area for CONlfirmation (ABOVE TREND). JPM: a sustained move above recent 1M highs would validate Financials’ resilience (ABOVE TREND). MSFT: failure to reclaim the 1W range would signal deeper CORRECTION.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (+55): (1W: +1.07% | 1M: -1.69%) RECOVERY — positive earnings headlines align with a short-term bounce, confirmatory. (Other high-sentiment names noted in the tape; limited overlap with top movers, monitor for follow-through.)

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AMZN (-45): (1W: -2.97% | 1M: -5.05%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines and weak price action align. ADBE (-45): (1W: -8.58% | 1M: +2.41%) CORRECTION — bearish headlines coincide with heavy selling, watch for distribution. PLTR (-45): (1W: -6.42% | 1M: +11.81%) CORRECTION — negative commentary amid recent long-term gains, tactical risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. NVDA (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +4.56%) ABOVE TREND and Energy names (MPC ABOVE TREND, VLO ABOVE TREND) showing relative strength. Key risk: major megacap divergences (MSFT CORRECTION, V/MA CORRECTION, PLTR CORRECTION) and headline-driven distribution in some names — monitor sentiment-confirmation before increasing exposure.
